scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n web,api -c cyan,green "vp dev --host 0.0.0.0" "vp exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch server/index.ts"
scripts.build: vp build && vp pack server/index.ts --format esm --out-dir dist-server --sourcemap
scripts.db:setup: vp run db:migrate && vp run db:seed
scripts.test:crm: vp exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --test server/crm-api.test.ts server/crm-transfer.test.ts
scripts.test:agent: vp exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --test server/agent-api.test.ts server/agent-access.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: vp exec tsx --test server/crm-utils.test.ts src/lib/calendar.test.ts src/lib/crm-transfer.test.ts server/public-config.test.ts src/lib/userorbit.test.ts server/node-frontend.test.ts src/components/icons.test.tsx
scripts.test:mail: vp exec tsx --test server/mail-provider.test.ts server/mail-ingress.test.ts server/mail-backend.test.ts server/mail-security.test.ts
scripts.test:all: vp run test:unit && vp run test:crm && vp run test:agent && vp run test:extension-auth && vp run test:extension-ui && vp run test:mail && vp run test:workspaces

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for your own empty database. Keep it secret. Orbit applies migrations on first API request.

BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL.description: Email for the initial founder login.

BOOTSTRAP_NAME.description: Name for the initial founder account.

BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD.description: Unique random password of at least 12 characters for the initial founder.
